option.name: --ascii
tip: Ascii text mode: convert end-of-lines using local conventions.
Supported only on some non-Unix systems; ignored on systems that do not support it.

option.name: --best
tip: Use the slowest compression method (best compression).
Compression level 9.

option.name: --decompress
tip: Decompress.

option.name: --fast
tip: Use the fastest compression method (less compression).
Compression level 1.

option.name: --force
tip: Force compression or decompression even if the file has multiple links or the output already exists.
With --stdout, copy unrecognized input unchanged so zcat behaves like cat.

option.name: --help
tip: Display a help screen and quit.

option.name: --keep
tip: Keep (don't delete) input files during compression or decompression.

option.name: --license
tip: Display the gzip license and quit.

option.name: --list
tip: List compressed file contents.
Use with --verbose for method, CRC, date and totals.

option.name: --name
tip: When compressing, always save the original file name and timestamp.
When decompressing, restore them if present.
This is the default when compressing.

option.name: --no-name
tip: When compressing, do not save the original file name and timestamp.
When decompressing, do not restore them; this is the default.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress all warnings.

option.name: --recursive
tip: Travel the directory structure recursively and process all files found.

option.name: --rsyncable
tip: Make the compressed output rsync-friendly.
Allows rsync to transfer only changed parts of the archive.

option.name: --suffix
tip: Use suffix SUF on compressed files instead of .gz.
Any non-empty suffix without / is allowed; .z and .gz are recommended.
When decompressing, try SUF first when deriving the output name.

option.name: --synchronous
tip: Use synchronous output.
Safer if the system crashes, but considerably slower.

option.name: --test
tip: Test the compressed file integrity, then quit.

option.name: --to-stdout
tip: Write output on standard output and keep original files unchanged.
With several input files, the output is a sequence of independently compressed members.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Display the name and percentage reduction for each file compressed or decompressed.

option.name: --version
tip: Display the version number and compilation options, then quit.
Use compression level 2.
Use compression level 3.
Use compression level 4.
Use compression level 5.
Use compression level 6 (the default).
Use compression level 7.
Use compression level 8.
